title: Revised Cardiac Risk Index (RCRI)
sources: Duceppe E et al. CCS. Can J Cardiol 2017;33:17-32

changelog.change: Tier 1 verification: replaced the unsourced Class III (~2.4%) / IV (~5.4%+) risk figures with the Lee 1999 validation-cohort rates (0.4 / 0.9 / 6.6 / 11%). Score logic and class boundaries were confirmed correct.

purpose: Perioperative risk of major cardiac events (MI, pulmonary edema, VF/arrest, complete heart block) for noncardiac surgery; informs the need for further workup and monitoring.

items.label: High-risk surgery (intraperitoneal, intrathoracic, or suprainguinal vascular)
History of cerebrovascular disease (stroke or TIA)

interpretation.label: Class IV
interpretation.disposition: Functional-capacity assessment, consider biomarkers (BNP/troponin) and cardiology input before elective surgery

notes: Risk figures are the Lee 1999 derivation/validation rates for death, MI, pulmonary edema, VF/arrest, or complete heart block within 30 days. Contemporary nationwide cohorts run somewhat lower for classes I-II (~0.2 / 1.0%) and similar-to-higher for III-IV (~4 / 8% up to 10 / 15%).
